about: Remote speakers name themselves ("this is Priya", "Daniel here") and then commit to work; owners must come from those introductions.
lines: Morning all. Let's go round the remote folks first for updates on the mobile release.
Hi, this is Priya from QA. Regression is done on Android, but iOS crashes when you open the camera on older iPhones.
I will log the crash with steps and a video by tomorrow.
Thanks Priya. Who on the iOS side can take it?
Hey, Daniel here. I can take the camera crash, I'll have a fix ready for testing by Thursday.
It's Aisha. The new onboarding screens are approved. I'll export the assets to the Figma handoff today.
Okay. So we agree the release moves to next Monday to give Daniel time for the fix.
Daniel again, one concern: do we need the App Store review expedited? Not sure who requests that.
Let's leave that open for now. I will draft the release notes this week.
